levels_about: N 0..10: 0 none, 5 the dataset normal median (the preset), 8 its strong median (at8), 10 its strong upper quartile (at10), linear between; a preset without at8 / at10 uses these gains on its N=5 values (ratios in the log domain)

question.source: measured: 5 question yn utterances of read speech vs the same speaker's statements (N=5 median, N=10 upper quartile); kept ['range_x']; final_st measured -2.754 st (q25 -2.832, q75 -2.624) is a fall: replaced by the built rise +4.0 / +5.6 / +7.2 st at N = 5 / 8 / 10
question.licence: LibriTTS-R test-clean (Koizumi et al. 2023, CC BY 4.0) + CSTR VCTK 0.92 (Yamagishi et al. 2019, CC BY 4.0); attribution required

question_wh.source: measured: 10 question wh utterances of read speech vs the same speaker's statements (N=5 median, N=10 upper quartile); kept ['declination_st_s']
question_wh.licence: LibriTTS-R test-clean (Koizumi et al. 2023, CC BY 4.0) + CSTR VCTK 0.92 (Yamagishi et al. 2019, CC BY 4.0); attribution required

exclamation.source: built: stronger accents, louder, wider range, falling end (the read-speech set has 3 exclamations with a statement baseline)

shout.source: composed: VAD least-squares map (fitted on the measured emotions) at arousal 0.6, dominance 0.4, with energy >= +10 dB, tilt >= +1.5, h1h2 <= -3, range <= 1.6
shout.licence: derived from the measured presets (see their licence)

whisper.source: composed: calm + strong breath / low level / flat (a true whisper also needs devoicing, which the 12 parameters do not have)
